neighbours.label: the word that completes a multi-word proper name (Astrophysical Journal, Royal Society, Indiana University, Baja California, Call of Duty), as against the same word used as a common noun
fire: The results were published in the New England Journal of Medicine last year.
He was elected a fellow of the Royal Society in 1952.
She earned her doctorate at Ohio State University before moving abroad.
The team drove from San Diego down into Baja California.
The study appeared in the British Medical Journal in March.
My younger brother plays Call of Duty every evening after school.
The lecture was hosted by the Royal Geographical Society in London.
The book was reissued by Oxford University Press in 1998.
quiet: The results were written in a small journal she kept by the bed.
He was elected to the board of a local society in 1952.
She earned her doctorate at a university in the north before moving abroad.
The team drove from San Diego down to the beach.
The study appeared in a medical journal in March.
My younger brother plays football every evening after school.
The lecture was hosted by a small hiking society in London.
The book was reissued by a university press in 1998.
